$description: Rhythm/position/integrity rules JSON Schema cannot express (enforcedBy 'semantic' => schema/semantic_validate.py validate()), schema-level rules (enforcedBy 'schema' => schema/pagespec.schema.json $comment ids), section-contract rules (enforcedBy 'contract' => schema/semantic_validate.py lint_contracts() and schema/section-contract.schema.json) and the whole-page-wrapper gate (enforcedBy 'gate' => extraction/wrapper_gate.py, run by verify_all.py). verify_all.py proves every rule id here exists in the layer that enforces it, and vice versa.

rules.description: nodes[] must follow the declared template's node list in order (a PageSpec is checked against its template's REAL node list, not in isolation).
Every node's section must appear in the declared template's node list.
Every template node with required:true must be present.
A node with repeatable:false may appear at most once (keyed on section + variant).
route must be one of the declared template's routes ('/' -> template.home only; '*' -> template.not-found).
theme must equal the declared template's theme.
At most one HERO-class section (semantic.category HERO, not an id prefix) per page, and exactly one on templates that list one. Named exception: template.not-found has no hero.
The HERO-class section must be the first main-region node. Named exception: template.not-found (no hero).
chrome.footer, when present, must be the last node.
template.not-found must never contain chrome.footer or chrome.scroll-progress (the source switches both off for the error page).

No string anywhere in a PageSpec may contain a scheme URL (http://, https://, any scheme://), a protocol-relative //host URL or a www. host; the only links are the local document, mailto: and tel: (the user required no outbound links).
Every text field's word count (tokens containing a letter or digit) must be <= its contract maxWords.
mode 'reference': each asset/link slot must carry exactly the assetRole its section contract pins. Every mode: the role must exist in assets/asset-roles.json.
mode 'reference' may only use a role's allowedReferenceSources; mode 'generated' must use 'placeholder:<role>' for every placeholder-only role.
mode 'generated' instances may not reuse Refire's proprietary copy: an exact (normalized) match of any proprietary field, or any shared run of 6 or more consecutive words with it.
mode 'generated' instances must use reserved example contact data: emails at example.com/.org/.net or a *.example/*.invalid host, and fictional +1 NXX-555-01XX phone numbers.
Text fields must not contain '<' or '>' (the accordion body is injected as raw HTML by the source).
Every PageSpec carries a required closed mode: 'reference' or 'generated' (schema enum). The semantic layer applies the consequences below.
mode 'generated': a reference-only or blocked-for-generation asset role may not appear anywhere; availability is pinned in code (PINNED_AVAILABILITY).
mode 'generated': an asset or placeholder link must use one of the generation-safe roles its field lists under generatedAssetRoles.
mode 'generated': the availability in assets/asset-roles.json must equal the pin in code for every role (the registry alone cannot loosen a role).
mode 'generated': every sourceBrand.patterns category must hold at least one compiled pattern; an empty registry fails closed instead of passing everything.
mode 'generated': no string may name the source brand (Refire, REFIRE, Refire Group, refire.com, PRISMA, spaced or obfuscated spellings). Patterns: assets/asset-roles.json sourceBrand.patterns.brand.
mode 'generated': no source call-to-action text ('view our brochure', 'Visit Us', 'Get Refire'). Patterns: sourceBrand.patterns.cta.

mode 'generated': no source marketing copy (company descriptor, founding story, expansion pitch, hero tagline, key statistics, event programme, booth ids, cookie and form microcopy). Patterns: sourceBrand.patterns.copy.
mode 'generated': no source domain, mailbox, placeholder mailto or phone number. Patterns: sourceBrand.patterns.url.
mode 'generated': no protected asset file or id (logo, product photos, hero film and poster, brochure, favicons, typeface, /int/ asset paths). Patterns: sourceBrand.patterns.asset.
mode 'generated': no real third-party identity named in the source (partner organisations, the trade fair and its city). The source names no individual. Patterns: sourceBrand.patterns.people.
No raw colour (hex, rgb/hsl/oklch/oklab/color-mix, CSS colour names in a declaration) in any PageSpec string; colour is owned by tokens/llm/token-catalog.json roles through the section contracts.
No raw length (px, rem, em, vw, vh) in any PageSpec string; spacing and sizing are owned by layout.* and component.* tokens through the section contracts.
No CSS declaration (font-family, font-size, padding, colour ...) in any PageSpec string: fonts and type come only from the approved type.* roles and font.family.brand through the contracts.
A '{token.id}' reference in a PageSpec string must name a token of tokens/llm/token-catalog.json.
A PageSpec has no token or style slot (tokens/llm/token-policy.json 'overrides'): even a catalog token written as a '{token.id}' reference in a string is rejected.
Observed convention: the page meta description equals the content.title-description description. Non-fatal notice when they differ.
Observed convention: stat card indexes run 1, 2, 3. Non-fatal notice otherwise.
Each node's motion object is closed (pattern, threshold, reducedMotionFallback only) and its pattern/threshold are const-locked per section type.
motion.reducedMotionFallback is required and must be 'none-in-source': it records the FACT that the source has no reduced-motion handling. It is not a recommendation.
overlay.contact content.formSubmission must be the const 'non-submitting'.
error.not-found copy and the not-found document title are const-locked to the stock strings.
assetRole is a closed enum; every slot pins its role with const.
href patterns admit only /int/files/*.pdf, mailto:, tel: and placeholder: values.
Every sections/*.json satisfies the closed schema/section-contract.schema.json: no unknown top-level field, constraints closed, retrievalEligibleReason only when retrievalEligible is false.

Provenance and taxonomy are separate closed objects: source {id, tag, file, lines} says where the section is implemented (verify_all.py resolves it against the real file), semantic {id, category} says what it is for (category is a closed enum; semantic.id equals the contract id). Neither may stand in for the other.

Utility/runtime UI (cookie banner, loading overlay, pointer layer, modal dialog) carries a closed boolean retrievalEligible:false with a reason of 30+ characters; every other section is true. The ineligible set equals the code pins in semantic_validate.py and, independently, verify_all.py, and the allowlist's retrievalIneligibleSections.

Whole-page-wrapper gate over measured section heights (extraction/measured-values.json sectionHeights, 1440px): a HERO section above 1800px warns and above 3000px fails; one in-flow section holding more than 50% of its page warns and more than 60% fails; a fail is waived only by an entry in extraction/wrapper-whitelist.json (reviewedBy, justification of 30+ characters, maxHeightPx above the measured height). A missing measurement is an error.

adjacencyNote: Derived from the single real home sequence; with every home node required, the adjacency is fixed rather than a free recommendation.

motionBudget.note: observed maxima; enforced indirectly because the sections carrying them are non-repeatable
